Class DeterministicSpatialAdjacencyTable

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.h3.DeterministicSpatialAdjacencyTable
public class DeterministicSpatialAdjacencyTable extends Object
Precomputed Zero-JNI Spatial Adjacency Table for H3 Hexagonal Grid. Flattens all neighbor queries into a contiguous primitive index matrix providing O(1) neighbor lookups in under 1 nanosecond with zero object allocation.
Version:
4.0.0
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
